items.raw_excerpt:

- Upload code + describe task (refactoring, security review, architecture, etc.) - All 6 models run in parallel (~2-5 min) - See side-by-side comparison with AI judge scores - Community votes on winners (blind voting) - Each evaluation gets reflected in the overall AI model leaderboard, showing us best ones Why I built this: Existing benchmarks (HumanEval, SWE-Bench) don't reflect real-world developer tasks. It's basically admitting your content isn't complete, but making that useful. GDPR-compliant, local analytics, works retroactively.
Bad idea or pragmatic solution?

excerpt_i18n.en:
On October 10, 2025, the vivo Developer Conference (VDC) took place in Shenzhen, where the highly anticipated OriginOS 6 system officially debuted, drawing widespread attention both inside and outside the venue. However, in the view of Leifeng.com, the true hidden star of this VDC was the 2025 Blue Heart Intelligent Strategy, as the content of this strategic upgrade directly impacts the personal experience of every user.

With the strategic upgrade, vivo's Blue Heart large model achieved comprehensive breakthroughs. By 2025, AI in China is no longer a distant concept. Data shows that 78% of enterprises use AI in their operations, and 71% rely on generative AI for marketing, operations, and product development. When it comes to the practicality of AI, most people would likely agree it is useful.

However, such AI still carries a somewhat "corporate" feel and has not truly integrated into the daily lives of ordinary people. Take the most frequently used device—the smartphone—as an example: how many AI-related features do people actually use? Most probably treat large AI models merely as search engines; while practical, they are not yet user-friendly.

So, how can large AI models become more integrated into our lives and easier to use? vivo's answer is personalization. Indeed, current large models have extensive knowledge of the world but relatively little and short-term understanding of individuals, making it difficult to provide sustained, long-term personal service. Only when models become personalized can the full potential of large models be unleashed.

However, achieving personalized intelligence is not an easy task.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 10 de octubre de 2025, la Conferencia de Desarrolladores de vivo (VDC) se celebró en Shenzhen, donde el muy esperado sistema OriginOS 6 hizo su debut oficial, atrayendo innumerables miradas dentro y fuera del lugar. Sin embargo, en la opinión de Leifeng, el verdadero "protagonista oculto" de esta VDC fue en realidad la "Estrategia de Inteligencia Blue Heart 2025", ya que el contenido de esta actualización estratégica afecta la experiencia personal de cada usuario. Con la actualización estratégica, el gran modelo Blue Heart de vivo logró avances integrales. Al entrar en 2025, la IA en China ya no es un concepto inalcanzable. Los datos muestran que el 78% de las empresas utilizan IA en sus operaciones, y el 71% también emplea IA generativa para marketing, mantenimiento y desarrollo.

items.raw_excerpt: 作者|杨依婷 编辑|包永刚 在全球科技行业驶入AI时代的高速路时，存储产业正经历一场深刻的范式转移，过去周期性波动明显的市场，正被一股强劲而持续的结构性增长力量所主导。这一转变在近日举行的GMIF 2025创新峰会上成为共识。 长久以来，存储市场一直都有周期性的波动：当产能过剩时价格暴跌，需求回升又带来短暂反弹。在AI需求的带动下，存储行业正进入持续高增长通道。 市场预测显示，2025年新型存储市场规模将接近2000亿美元，同比增长约17%；到2027年，新型存储的市场规模预计将进一步扩大至约2300亿美元。 爱集微咨询总经理韩晓敏在GMIF 2025创新峰会上分析道：“这次推动存储行业复苏的动力，不再是手机和PC，而是AI驱动的计算需求。”他表示，目前，这一增长的主要驱动力仍来自北美互联网巨头的大规模投资，中国虽然在全球AI产业中位居第二，但由于先进芯片供应受限，发展能力受到一定程度的制约。 不过，近期包括阿里、字节在内的国内主要互联网企业，纷纷上调了未来几年在云基础设施建设方面的投资计划。韩晓敏认为，这一动向意味着市场的实际增速可能超出此前17%的普遍预期，有望达到约22%。 同时，AI模型训练的高密度算力需求也让数据量呈指数级增长，这也将推动对存储的需求。闪迪产品市场总监张丹总结了AI时代的数据特征——“4V”：体量巨大、种类多样、价值密集、实时性强，预计全球数据总量将在2025年突破200ZB。“AI正在让数据从被动存储变为主动驱动，存储性能正决定AI体验。”她强调。 在这一趋势下，市场焦点正从“存多少”转向“怎么存”，容量扩张不再是竞争核心，更重要的是如何让数据流动得更快、更智能、更节能。更多资讯，欢迎添加雷峰网作者微信EATINGNTAE。 直面“内存墙”：AI存储集体“破墙开路” AI的高并行计算模式带来了前所未有的带宽与延迟挑战，也推动了以HBM、AI SS

Author: Yang Yiting | Editor: Bao Yonggang
As the global tech industry accelerates into the AI era, the storage sector is undergoing a profound paradigm shift. The once cyclical market is now dominated by strong, sustained structural growth, a consensus highlighted at the recent GMIF 2025 Innovation Summit.

Historically, the storage market has experienced cyclical fluctuations: prices plummet during oversupply and rebound briefly with rising demand. Driven by AI needs, the industry is entering a phase of continuous high growth.

Market forecasts indicate the new storage market will reach nearly $200 billion by 2025, a 17% year-on-year increase, and is expected to expand to approximately $230 billion by 2027.

At the summit, Han Xiaomin, General Manager of Aijiwei Consulting, analyzed that the current recovery in storage is fueled not by smartphones and PCs but by AI-driven computing demands. He noted that while North American internet giants lead this growth with massive investments, China, ranking second globally in AI, faces constraints due to limited advanced chip supply.

However, recent increases in cloud infrastructure investment plans by major Chinese internet firms like Alibaba and ByteDance suggest actual market growth may exceed the 17% forecast, potentially reaching around 22%.

Mientras la industria tecnológica global acelera hacia la era de la IA, el sector del almacenamiento está experimentando un profundo cambio de paradigma. Un mercado antes marcado por fluctuaciones cíclicas evidentes está siendo impulsado por una fuerza de crecimiento estructural sólida y sostenida. Este cambio fue un consenso en la reciente Cumbre de Innovación GMIF 2025. Durante mucho tiempo, el mercado de almacenamiento ha mostrado oscilaciones cíclicas: los precios se desploman con el exceso de capacidad y repuntan brevemente con la recuperación de la demanda. Impulsado por la demanda de IA, el sector se adentra en una fase de alto crecimiento continuo. Las proyecciones indican que el mercado de almacenamiento emergente alcanzará casi 200 mil millones de dólares en 2025, con un crecimiento interanual de aproximadamente un 1%.

1. El negocio más rentable de Film Storm es el comercio electrónico, con 200 000 camisetas vendidas este año.
2. Xiaopeng Motors cambia de líder en conducción autónoma: Liu Xianming, responsable del modelo base mundial, asume el cargo.

4. Alibaba se adentra en la inteligencia encarnada: equipo interno Qwen formado, liderado por el responsable técnico de Tongyi Qianwen.
5. ¡Prima del 55%! El robot humanoide G1 de Yushu disponible en Walmart EE. UU., modelo básico a 21 600 dólares.
6. Shao Shili, responsable de mercados internacionales de Lefen, deja la empresa, posiblemente para emprender.
